classes.name: Odysseus of Ithaca
classes.blurb: King of Ithaca, ten years at Troy, and still not home. The wooden horse was your idea. You have never won a fight you could win another way, which is fortunate, because nothing in this cave can be won by fighting. A short sword you will barely draw, pitch-pine to hold back the dark, and the grey-eyed goddess watching over your shoulder. The strong wine of Maron waits in the hold below; the men will carry it up when the moment comes. There is no one else to be on this island — the crew are yours, and so is whatever you talk them into.
